title: Land of Ahhhs | KEY.co
description_expanded: Land of Ahhhs in Seacrest Beach, Florida, is a luxurious four-bedroom, four-and-a-half-bathroom beach vacation home that offers all the comforts of home and more. Located in the prestigious Magnolia Cottages by the Sea along the famed 30A, this retreat is designed for those who crave a blend of coastal charm and modern conveniences. The home features a large screened-in porch perfect for relaxing, a spacious living area ideal for gatherings, and a fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar for casual dining. The master bedroom on the main floor boasts a king bed, complemented by two additional bedrooms each with a king bed, and a fourth bedroom with two bunk beds and a trundle, making it perfect for families. Surrounded by the natural beauty of Seacrest Beach, guests can easily walk or bike to nearby attractions including the neighboring Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. The convenient Beach Access at Gulf Lakes allows for seamless entry to the pristine sandy shores, while the resort-style pool offers a tranquil escape amidst the wooded landscape. Magnolia Cottages by the Sea ensures an unforgettable stay where every detail is curated to provide a luxurious and memorable beachside experience. Whether lounging by the pool, exploring the scenic 30A, or enjoying the comfort of this beautifully appointed home, Land of Ahhhs is the perfect destination for an idyllic family getaway.
